notes.title: Ministry of Order reaches 20,000 wishlists!
notes.notes: [p]🎉 Ministry of Order just hit [b]20,000 wishlists[/b] on Steam! 🎉[/p][p]We want to thank all the players who’ve supported us on this journey, and a special shoutout to the Women-Led Games Festival team for featuring our game in their showcase - it truly made this milestone possible.[/p][p]The festival may be over, but their page is still live - go check out the amazing games featured there if you haven’t already: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/43765559/sale/Women-LedGamesSummerGameFestEdition2025" style="button"]Women-Led Games 2025 Steam Page[/url][/p][p]❤️ Every wishlist, share, and comment counts - it really makes a difference! So if you haven’t yet, hit that wishlist button! [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3572310/Ministry_of_Order/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Women-Led Games Showcase
notes.notes: [p]🎉 The [b]Women-Led Games Showcase[/b] is now LIVE![/p][p]Watch our brand new [i]Ministry of Order[/i] reveal trailer - alongside 38 other incredible indie games 📺 [/p][previewyoutube="LsDFjNW8jhA;full"][/previewyoutube][p]We’d love to hear your thoughts - what did you like, and what could be better? Your feedback means the world to us.[/p][p]Huge thanks to the Women-Led Games team for featuring us, and to everyone tuning in to support indie devs! 💜[/p]

notes.title: Ministry of Order will be featured in the Women-Led Games Showcase!
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce that Ministry of Order will be featured in the Women-Led Games Showcase!
🗓️ Tune in on June 7th at 10 AM PT / 1 PM ET / 17:00 UTC
📺 Watch it here: https://www.youtube.com/@Women-LedGames

We’ll be revealing some exciting new details about the game - including fresh mechanics, new characters, and more surprises!

The Women-Led Games Showcase is part of the larger Summer Game Fest event, which kicks off on June 6th.

Thank you all for supporting Ministry of Order, and a huge thanks to the Women-Led Games team for including us!
